blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Mandaue City is targeting to distribute P10,000 in cash assistance to each public school teaching and non-teaching personnel under the Department of Education (DepEd)-Mandaue in December, following the passage of a city council resolution urging the release of the funds. Councilor Joel Seno, chairman of the committees on Appropriations, Budget and Finance and Education, proposed Draft Resolution No. 591-2026, requesting the Local Finance Committee (LFC) to release the financial assistance to all DepEd public school teaching and non-teaching personnel assigned within Mandaue City. The assistance is provided under Ordinance No. 14-2018-1387, which grants P10,000 in cash assistance […]...
